## Bearer

RaceListScreen (RaceListCard) — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/racelist/RaceListScreen.kt

## Trigger

None — a rendering property of each `Text` composable, applied at
composition whenever the screen renders. Already observed on every
frame; nothing new needs to call it.

## Today

No `Text` composable in either module sets `maxLines` or `overflow` —
confirmed by grepping both `app-phone/src/main/java` and
`app-wear/src/main/java` for `maxLines`, `TextOverflow` and
`overflow`: zero matches in either tree.

Six places render a user-entered or synced race name with no bound:

- `RaceListScreen.kt` — `RaceListCard`: the name `Text` (line ~149)
  and the total-time `Text` (line ~156) sit in a
  `Row(horizontalArrangement = SpaceBetween)` with neither `Text`
  carrying a `weight` — confirmed, no `.weight(` call anywhere in the
  file. A long name wraps onto extra lines and can push the total-time
  `Text` out of its row, since nothing constrains the name's width.
- `RaceDetailScreen.kt` — `RaceDetailHeader`: the title `Text`
  (`uiState.name`, line 56) has no bound.
- `RaceDetailScreen.kt` — `DeleteConfirmDialog`: the title `Text`
  (`PhoneStringResources.DeleteConfirm.title(uiState.name)`, line 264)
  interpolates the race name into the confirmation dialog's title with
  no bound.
- `WatchHistoryScreen.kt` — `WatchHistoryRow`: the name `Text`
  (`row.name`, line 77) has no bound, on a screen already narrower
  than the phone.
- `HomeScreen.kt` (watch) — the `referenceLineText` `Text` (line 38),
  which carries the reference race's name, has no bound.
- `PreparationScreen.kt` (watch) — the `referenceLoadedText` `Text`
  (line 93), which also carries the reference race's name, has no
  bound.

## Expected

Every `Text` rendering a race name or a label built from one — the
race list row's name, the detail title, the delete confirmation's
title, the watch history row's name, and the two reference-race
labels on `HomeScreen` and `PreparationScreen` — sets a `maxLines` and
an overflow behaviour (`TextOverflow.Ellipsis`) sized to its own
context, so a long value never reshapes the layout around it.
Specifically, `RaceListCard`'s name `Text` also gets a `Modifier.weight(1f)`
so it cannot push the total-time `Text` out of its row when the name
is long.
